title: blank grid
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate structured grid blanking using an image and scalar values on PLOT3D combustor data, displayed side by side.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkBlankStructuredGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBlankStructuredGrid.html) — blank structured grid.
- [vtkBlankStructuredGridWithImage](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBlankStructuredGridWithImage.html) — blank structured grid with image.
- [vtkDataSetAttributes](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetAttributes.html) — data set attributes.
- [vtkExtractGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkExtractGrid.html) — extract grid.
- [vtkImageData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageData.html) — represents a regular grid of points (image/volume).
- [vtkMultiBlockPLOT3DReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMultiBlockPLOT3DReader.html) — reads PLOT3D structured grid files.
- [vtkNamedColors](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkNamedColors.html) — named colors.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkStructuredGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStructuredGrid.html) — structured grid.
- [vtkStructuredGridGeometryFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStructuredGridGeometryFilter.html) — structured grid geometry filter.
- [vtkStructuredGridOutlineFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStructuredGridOutlineFilter.html) — generates an outline of a structured grid.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
